from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from fractions import Fraction
import json,subprocess,tempfile,traceback
import mpmath as mp
folder=Path(tempfile.gettempdir());mf=folder/'s169bd-closeout.json';meta=json.loads(mf.read_bytes())
root=Path(meta['satellite_root']);stem='current-reference-rescaled-source-test'
receipt=json.loads((root/'evidence'/f'{stem}.json').read_bytes());run=receipt['runs'][-1]
evfile=root/'evidence'/f'{stem}-closeout-verification.json'
ev=json.loads(evfile.read_bytes()) if evfile.exists() else {'attempts':[]}
attempt={'source_utf8':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'source_sha256':sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def bounds(x):
 a=x['decimal_enclosure'];unit=Fraction(10)**int(a['exponent']);mid=Fraction(a['mid'])*unit;rad=Fraction(a['rad'])*unit
 return mid-rad,mid,mid+rad
def dm(x,i=1):
 f=bounds(x)[i];return Decimal(f.numerator)/Decimal(f.denominator)
def mm(x):
 f=bounds(x)[1];return mp.mpf(f.numerator)/f.denominator
def out(x,digits=8):
 with localcontext() as c:
  c.prec=digits;c.rounding='ROUND_CEILING';return str(+x)
try:
 assert run['status']=='passed' and all(r['passed'] for r in run['checks'])
 assert all(sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in run['input_sha256_after'].items())
 for kind in ['planning','satellite']:
  rr=Path(meta[kind+'_root'])
  assert all(sha256((rr/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in meta[kind+'_inherited'].items())
  assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=rr,text=True).strip()==meta[kind+'_previous_commit']
  assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=rr).strip()
 par=next(r for r in run['numerics'] if r['kind']=='physical_reference_prefactor_test')
 src=next(r for r in run['numerics'] if r['kind']=='known_joint_local_source_test')
 qresults=[]
 for precision in [70,100]:
  mp.mp.dps=precision;nu=mm(src['fractional_power']);zh=mm(src['zh'])
  def parse(rows,shift=0):return [(r['z_power']+shift,r['y_integer_power']+r['fractional_multiplicity']*nu,mm(r['coefficient'])) for r in rows]
  trial=parse(src['trial'],-4);scalar=parse(src['scaled_scalar_integrand_coefficients']);shape=parse(src['shape_integrand_coefficients'])
  def val(terms,z):return sum(c*z**k*(1-z)**a for k,a,c in terms)
  nodes=[mp.mpf(0),mp.mpf('.5'),mp.mpf('.9'),mp.mpf('.99'),mp.mpf('.9999'),zh]
  # Direct numerical quadrature is independent of the production power primitives.
  isc=mp.quad(lambda z:val(trial,z)*val(scalar,z),nodes)
  ish=mp.quad(lambda z:val(shape,z),nodes)
  joint=(isc-ish)/mm(par['F_lambda'])
  def inside(x,enc):
   lo,_,hi=bounds(enc);return mp.mpf(lo.numerator)/lo.denominator<x<mp.mpf(hi.numerator)/hi.denominator
  assert inside(ish,src['known_R2_trace_shape'])
  assert inside(joint,src['rescaled_known_trace_component'])
  qresults.append({'digits':precision,'shape':mp.nstr(ish,65),'joint':mp.nstr(joint,65)})
 assert abs(mp.mpf(qresults[0]['joint'])-mp.mpf(qresults[1]['joint']))<mp.mpf('1e-75')
 with localcontext() as c:
  c.prec=120
  Fl=dm(par['F_lambda']);eps=dm(par['epsilon_R'])
  assert abs(Fl+eps-1)<Decimal('1e-110')
  bolt=eps/Fl*Decimal('3.33e-10');assert bolt<Decimal('4e-18')
  ptlo=dm(src['rescaled_known_trace_component'],0);pthi=dm(src['rescaled_known_trace_component'],2)
  numerical=dm(src['numerical_scalar_error_upper'],2)
  known=max(abs(ptlo),abs(pthi))+numerical
  principal=dm(src['remaining_principal_stress_upper'],2)
  assert known<Decimal('1e-42') and principal<Decimal('1e-43')
  assert known+principal<Decimal('1.1e-42')
  factor=dm(src['inherited_scalar_contact_upper_allowance'],2)/Decimal('2.60e-40')
  assert factor>22 and factor<23
  pc=dm(src['principal_coefficient'])*Decimal(32)/21
  assert abs(pc-dm(src['remaining_principal_stress_upper']))<Decimal('1e-80')
  result=dict(known_trace_component_upper=out(known),remaining_principal_stress_upper=out(principal),
   sum_closed_components_upper=out(known+principal),physical_trial_bolt_change_upper=out(max(bolt,dm(par['physical_trial_bolt_change_upper'],2))),
   new_first_bolt_upper=out(dm(par['new_first_bolt_upper'],2)),
   scalar_contact_upper_allowance=out(dm(src['inherited_scalar_contact_upper_allowance'],2)),
   scalar_contact_allowance_target_factor=out(factor),remaining_signed_source_target='2.589e-40',working_projection_ceiling='2.60e-40',
   independent_quadrature=qresults,complete_signed_source_evaluated=False,total_source_improvement_certified=False)
 frozen={p:sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in run['frozen_sources_utf8']}
 assert all(run['input_sha256_after'][p]==h for p,h in frozen.items())
 meta.update(checks=len(run['checks']),inputs=len(run['input_sha256_after']),runs=len(receipt['runs']),
  failed_runs=sum(r['status']!='passed' for r in receipt['runs']),json_rows=len((root/'evidence'/f'{stem}.log').read_text().splitlines()),
  scientific_frozen_sha256=frozen,independent_result=result)
 mf.write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 attempt.update(status='passed',results=result,scientific_source_hashes=frozen,
  scope='Independent 70/100-digit direct quadrature versus production exact interval moments, Decimal physical budgets and unchanged-input/inherited-path audit. Quadrature is supplementary; interval and ordinary domain arguments retain their scopes.')
except Exception:
 attempt.update(status='failed',exception=traceback.format_exc())
ev['attempts'].append(attempt);evfile.write_text(json.dumps(ev,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:attempt[k] for k in ['status','results','exception'] if k in attempt}),flush=True)
if attempt['status']!='passed':raise SystemExit(1)
